accessibility_describe.title: Accessibility Describe
accessibility_describe.description:
An accessibility-focused image analysis node that generates scene descriptions 
optimized for blind and visually impaired users. Powered by Google Gemini Vision, 
it provides structured descriptions including spatial layout (clock positions), 
hazard detection, text reading (OCR), people detection, and navigation guidance. 
Designed for real-time assistive technology applications like smart glasses.

agent_crewai.title: CrewAI Agent
agent_crewai.description:
Standalone single-agent CrewAI node.
Can be invoked as a tool (`<nodeId>.run_agent`) by other agents.
For multi-agent delegation, use a CrewAI Manager + CrewAI Subagent nodes.

llm.description: LLM used by the agent

tool.description: Tools available to the agent (via control-plane invoke)

agent_crewai_manager.title: CrewAI Manager
agent_crewai_manager.description:
Multi-agent manager using CrewAI hierarchical process.
Fans out to connected CrewAI Subagent nodes, assembles a Crew, and synthesizes their outputs.
Can be invoked as a tool (`<nodeId>.run_agent`) for nested orchestration.

llm.description: LLM used by the manager agent

agent_crewai_subagent.title: CrewAI Subagent
agent_crewai_subagent.description:
Managed CrewAI sub-agent. Must be wired into a CrewAI Manager via the crewai channel.
Cannot be invoked directly, has no questions lane.

llm.description: LLM used by this sub-agent when delegated to

tool.description: Tools available to this sub-agent (via control-plane invoke)

agent_deepagent.title: Deep Agent
agent_deepagent.description:
Single-agent execution using Deep Agents.
Adds strategic planning, persistent state, and long-context management on top of LangChain.
Connect Deep Agent Subagent nodes via the deepagent invoke channel for hierarchical delegation.
Can be invoked as a tool (`<nodeId>.run_agent`) by other agents.

deepagent.description: Optional DeepAgent Subagent nodes for hierarchical delegation

llm.description: LLM used by the agent

tool.description: Tools available to the agent (via control-plane invoke)

agent_deepagent_subagent.title: Deep Agent Subagent
agent_deepagent_subagent.description:
Managed Deep Agent subagent. Must be wired into a Deep Agent node via the deepagent channel.
Cannot be invoked directly, has no questions lane.

llm.description: LLM used by this sub-agent when delegated to

tool.description: Tools available to this sub-agent (via control-plane invoke)

agent_langchain.title: LangChain
agent_langchain.description:
Single-agent execution using LangChain.
Can be invoked as a tool (`<nodeId>.run_agent`) for hierarchical agent orchestration.

llm.description: LLM used by the agent

tool.description: Tools available to the agent (via control-plane invoke)

agent_llamaindex.title: LlamaIndex
agent_llamaindex.description:
Single-agent execution using LlamaIndex's ReAct loop.
Can be invoked as a tool (`<nodeId>.run_agent`) for hierarchical agent orchestration.

llm.description: LLM used by the agent

tool.description: Tools available to the agent (via control-plane invoke)

agent_rocketride.title: RocketRide Wave
agent_rocketride.description:
Wave-planning agent built natively on the RocketRide architecture.
Plans each step as a wave of parallel tool calls, uses keyed memory to stay token-efficient,
and requests tool schemas on demand instead of loading them all upfront.
Can be invoked as a tool (`<nodeId>.run_agent`) for hierarchical agent orchestration.

llm.description: LLM used by the agent for planning and synthesis

memory.description: Keyed memory for the agent (via control-plane invoke)

tool.description: Tools available to the agent (via control-plane invoke)

anomaly_detector.title: Anomaly Detector
anomaly_detector.description:
A pipeline monitoring component that detects anomalies in numeric output values using 
statistical methods. It supports Z-Score, IQR (Interquartile Range), and Rolling Average 
deviation detection with configurable sensitivity and window sizes. Detected anomalies are 
classified by severity (normal, warning, critical) and added to document metadata.</br>
</br>
Use this node to monitor pipeline outputs for unexpected patterns, outliers, or shifts 
in data distribution that may indicate issues requiring attention.

anonymize_text.title: Anonymize
anonymize_text.description:
A filter component that identifies and masks sensitive information in text data. It can be configured to detect and redact personally identifiable information (PII), maintaining data privacy while preserving document context.

Note: This component uses AI so 100% accuracy is not guaranteed. It is recommended to review the results.

answer_documents.title: Answers to Documents
answer_documents.description:
An adapter component that turns model/agent answers into embeddable documents. 
It reads the answers lane and emits one document per validated fact (a JSON array 
yields one document per item; a JSON object or plain-text answer yields a single 
document), so an LLM's structured, self-describing output can be embedded and indexed 
back into a vector store. The original answer is also passed through unchanged, letting 
a pipeline index the answer and keep serving it in the same run.

aparavi_aql.title: Aparavi AQL
aparavi_aql.description:
Queries the Aparavi data governance platform using AQL (Aparavi Query Language). 
Accepts natural-language questions, generates AQL SELECT statements via the 
connected LLM, and returns file metadata rows from the Aparavi STORE table. 
Schema is fixed, no dynamic introspection required.

llm.description: LLM used to generate AQL queries from natural language

astra_db.title: Astra DB
astra_db.description:
A vector database component for Astra DB, enabling efficient storage and 
retrieval of vector embeddings. It supports similarity search, filtering, 
and management of vector data with high performance and advanced matching capabilities.

audio_player.title: Player
audio_player.description:
The Audio Player component plays audio through the system’s default audio
output device, including the audio track from video content. It supports
a variety of common audio formats and delivers clear, consistent playback
for speech, music, or sound effects.

audio_transcribe.title: Transcribe
audio_transcribe.description: The Audio transcribe component recieves audio or video and transcribes into text.

audio_tts.title: Text To Speech
audio_tts.description:
Converts incoming text into speech using Kokoro-82M (local KPipeline or --modelserver KokoroLoader).
Output is sent on the audio lane as WAV bytes.
See README for spaCy en_core_web_sm (misaki) and troubleshooting.

background_removal.title: Background Removal
background_removal.description:
Foreground / background separation using BiRefNet (MIT). Returns an RGBA cutout with a straight (non-premultiplied) alpha channel, so downstream nodes can re-composite over any background without dark fringes. 
Two profiles are shipped: the default 1K BiRefNet and a higher-resolution 2K variant for fine hair / detailed edges. Runs on CPU, Apple Silicon (MPS), and CUDA.

input.description: AVI image stream to remove the background from.

output.description: RGBA PNG (straight alpha) as raw stream — pipe to any node accepting image input.

chat.title: Chat
chat.description:
A user interface component that provides a web-based chat experience. It 
creates its own HTTP endpoint, configured by host and port, to serve a simple 
chat UI. Users can interact with the interface to submit questions, which 
are routed through the attached pipeline for processing. Designed for easy 
integration, it enables the addition of conversational capabilities to any 
pipeline workflow.

chroma.title: Chroma
chroma.description:
A vector database component for Chroma, enabling efficient storage and 
retrieval of vector embeddings. It supports similarity search, filtering, 
and management of vector data with high performance.

currency_convert_explicit.title: Currency Convert (Explicit)
currency_convert_explicit.description:
An opt-in currency converter for the audit-grade financial extraction suite. Converts fact values from a source currency to a target currency at a stated rate and date supplied in the configuration — conversion is never implicit or fetched from a live rate. Reads and writes the answers lane.

The conversion is non-destructive: the original amount and currency are kept, a converted block is added, and a provenance entry records the rate, date and source/target currencies. Records that are not fact objects, or whose currency does not match the configured source, pass through unchanged.

db_arango.title: ArangoDB
db_arango.description:
A processing component that connects to an ArangoDB multi-model database. 
Accepts natural-language questions, translates them to read-only AQL queries 
via an LLM, and returns results to the pipeline. Works across documents, graphs 
and ArangoSearch views — designed for document retrieval, graph traversal, and RAG workflows.

llm.description: LLM to use to craft AQL queries from question

db_clickhouse.title: ClickHouse
db_clickhouse.description:
A ClickHouse component that answers natural-language questions by translating 
them into SQL and executing them against the database, returning rows as a table, 
text, or structured answers. It also exposes an agent tool surface (get_data, 
get_schema, get_sql) for question-to-SQL querying. Read-only by default; raw SQL 
execution is available to trusted callers via the allow_execute option.

llm.description: LLM to use to craft SQL queries from question

db_hotdata.title: Hotdata
db_hotdata.description:
Creates one ephemeral Hotdata database for each pipeline run.
Lets agents inspect its live schema and execute read-only SQL before the database is destroyed at teardown.

llm.description: LLM used to generate SQL from natural language

db_hydradb.title: HydraDB
db_hydradb.description:
A database/tool node for HydraDB, a managed graph + memory store. 
Exposes agent-callable tools to store text as memories (with automatic knowledge-graph 
extraction) and recall graph-enriched context by natural-language query. Retrieval is 
HydraDB's native server-side search - no embeddings or query language required.

db_mysql.title: MySQL
db_mysql.description:
A processing component that takes structured table data and inserts it 
into a MySQL database. Designed for straightforward data ingestion, it 
supports field mapping and basic configuration of connection credentials 
and target tables. Ideal for storing processed results or structured outputs, 
this component ensures reliable insertion of records into relational storage.

llm.description: LLM to use to craft SQL queries from question

db_postgres.title: PostgreSQL
db_postgres.description:
A processing component that takes structured table data and inserts it 
into a PostgreSQL database. Designed for straightforward data ingestion, it 
supports field mapping and basic configuration of connection credentials 
and target tables. Ideal for storing processed results or structured outputs, 
this component ensures reliable insertion of records into relational storage.

llm.description: LLM to use to craft SQL queries from question

db_supabase.title: Supabase
db_supabase.description:
A processing component that takes structured table data and inserts it 
into a Supabase (PostgreSQL) database. Designed for straightforward data ingestion, it 
supports field mapping and basic configuration of connection credentials 
and target tables. Use the Supavisor pooler from your Supabase dashboard (works over IPv4); 
the direct connection is IPv6-only. The connection is encrypted over TLS.

llm.description: LLM to use to craft SQL queries from question

depth_estimate.title: Depth Estimation
depth_estimate.description:
Monocular depth estimation using Depth Anything V2 Small (Apache-2.0). 
Outputs a colorized depth map (red = near, blue = far); depth statistics (min, max, mean) are emitted as JSON on the text lane.
Pair with the Object Detection node to get rough distance to detected objects. 
Runs on CPU, Apple Silicon (MPS), and CUDA.

input.description: AVI image stream to estimate depth from.

output.description: Colorized depth map as raw stream — red is near, blue is far.

detect.title: Object Detection
detect.description:
Per-frame object detection. RF-DETR (Apache-2.0, default) is a fast closed-set detector over 80 COCO classes (person, car, dog, etc.). MM-Grounding-DINO (Apache-2.0/BSD-3) is the open-vocab option: type a prompt to detect anything. 
Image in, bounding boxes + labels + centroids out. 
Use as a fast per-frame gate before heavier models. For pixel masks use Segmentation.

input.description: AVI image stream to run detection on.

output.description: Annotated image as raw stream - pipe to any node accepting image input.
JSON array of detections: [{label, score, box, centroid}].

detect_segment.title: Segmentation
detect_segment.description:
Pixel-level segmentation with HuggingFace-native engines: 
Mask2Former-instance (MIT, default) for closed-set instance masks; 
Mask2Former-semantic (MIT) for per-pixel class maps. 
Image in (single frame or multi-frame via frame_grabber documents); annotated overlay + Masks JSON out.

output.description: Annotated image (translucent mask overlay) as raw stream.
Masks JSON. instance: [{label, score, box, mask}]. semantic: {semantic_map, classes, size}.

dictionary.title: Dictionary
dictionary.description:
A processing component that analyzes documents to extract a dictionary of 
key terms and phrases. It identifies domain-specific vocabulary, recurring 
expressions, and relevant terminology, building a structured list for downstream 
enrichment or reference. Useful for creating glossaries, supporting classification, 
or enhancing search relevance, the component helps surface important language patterns 
from unstructured content.

llm.description: LLM to use for Dictionary creation

dropper.title: Dropper
dropper.description:
A user interface component that provides a web-based dropper experience. It 
creates its own HTTP endpoint, configured by host and port, to serve a simple 
dropper UI. Users can interact with the interface to submit questions, which 
are routed through the attached pipeline for processing. Designed for easy 
integration, it enables the addition of conversational capabilities to any 
pipeline workflow.

elasticsearch.title: Elasticsearch
elasticsearch.description:
A vector database component for Elasticsearch, enabling efficient storage and 
retrieval of vector embeddings. It supports similarity search, filtering, 
and management of vector data with high performance. Supports Elastic Cloud 
Serverless, Elastic Cloud Hosted, and self-managed Elasticsearch deployments.

embedding_image.title: Image
embedding_image.description:
A processing component that generates vector embeddings from image content 
using advanced computer vision models. It transforms visual features into 
numerical representations that capture the semantic and structural characteristics 
of the image. These embeddings enable similarity search, clustering, and 
integration into multimodal workflows. Ideal for use cases involving image retrieval, 
classification, or content understanding.

embedding_openai.title: OpenAI (Embedding)
embedding_openai.description:
A component that transforms text into numerical vector representations using advanced embedding 
models. It converts input text, ranging from individual words to entire documents, into high-dimensional 
vectors that capture semantic meaning and relationships. These embeddings enable efficient similarity 
searches, clustering, and other advanced natural language processing tasks. The text embedder is highly 
configurable, supporting various pre-trained models and fine-tuning options, ensuring flexibility for 
different use cases across domains.

embedding_transformer.title: Transformer
embedding_transformer.description:
A component that transforms text into numerical vector representations using advanced embedding 
models. It converts input text, ranging from individual words to entire documents, into high-dimensional 
vectors that capture semantic meaning and relationships. These embeddings enable efficient similarity 
searches, clustering, and other advanced natural language processing tasks. The text embedder is highly 
configurable, supporting various pre-trained models and fine-tuning options, ensuring flexibility for 
different use cases across domains.

embedding_video.title: Video
embedding_video.description:
A processing component that generates vector embeddings from video content 
by extracting frames at configurable intervals and encoding them using 
vision models such as CLIP. It transforms visual features from video frames 
into numerical representations that capture the semantic and structural 
characteristics of the video. These embeddings enable similarity search, 
clustering, and integration into multimodal RAG workflows. Ideal for use 
cases involving video retrieval, semantic search, and content understanding.

extract_data.title: Data Extractor
extract_data.description:
A component that processes unstructured or semi-structured text and extracts 
structured data in a tabular format. It identifies key fields, values, and 
patterns within the input content using configurable extraction rules or machine 
learning models. The resulting output is organized into rows and columns, making 
it suitable for further analysis, storage, or integration into downstream systems. This 
component is ideal for transforming documents, reports, or freeform text into usable 
data structures, enabling automation and insight generation across various domains.

llm.description: LLM to use for data extraction

extract_facts.title: Fact Extractor
extract_facts.description:
The extraction brain. Reads document context together with a table cell by cell, 
and runs a validator pass that double-checks the extracted values on disagreement, 
reconciling and tie-breaking before emitting fully-qualified facts. Each fact carries 
the user-configured target fields plus auto-attached provenance (page, table id, row, 
column, source text, and a confidence score) so downstream consumers can trace every 
value back to where it came from.

llm.description: LLM to use for fact extraction and validation

filestore.title: File Store
filestore.description:
File Store pipeline sink. Persists incoming lane data (documents, text, tables, and streamed image/audio/video) to the account-scoped RocketRide file store (the same store exposed via the client SDK's fs_* methods).
All writes are scoped to the task's storage anchor (the owning user's file tree for development runs, the task's team subtree for deployed runs), resolved automatically from the running task.
For each persisted file a JSON reference {path, url?} is emitted on the json lane; the signed url is included when 'Emit download URL' is enabled.

filestore_source.title: File Store Source
filestore_source.description:
File Store source. Streams files from the account-scoped RocketRide file store into the pipeline as raw objects for downstream processing.
Point it at a file to process just that file, or at a folder to process every file in it; enable 'Recursive' to also descend into subfolders.
Paths are relative to the task's storage anchor, resolved automatically from the running task.

filesys.title: Local File System
filesys.description:
A source component that reads data from the local file system. It 
enables ingestion of files and documents stored in directories for 
further processing within the pipeline. Configurable with path settings 
and file filters, the component supports flexible access to unstructured 
data across various formats.

frame_grabber.title: Frame Grabber
frame_grabber.description:
A component that extracts frames from video files and outputs them as image data. It 
supports a variety of video formats and allows users to specify frame extraction 
intervals (e.g., every 5 seconds or at specific time points). The component processes 
video content, extracting selected frames as image objects, which can then be passed downstream 
for further processing, analysis, or display.

graph_falkordb.title: FalkorDB
graph_falkordb.description:
A processing component that connects to a FalkorDB graph database. 
Accepts natural-language questions, translates them to Cypher queries 
via an LLM, and returns results to the pipeline. Also exposes the graph 
to an agent as a tool. Queries are read-only by default, enforced by the server.

llm.description: LLM to use to craft Cypher queries from question

graph_neo4j.title: Neo4J
graph_neo4j.description:
A processing component that connects to a Neo4J graph database. 
Accepts natural-language questions, translates them to Cypher queries 
via an LLM, and returns results to the pipeline. Designed for knowledge graph retrieval, 
entity linking, and graph-based RAG workflows.

llm.description: LLM to use to craft Cypher queries from question

guardrails.title: Guardrails
guardrails.description:
A comprehensive input/output guardrails filter for AI safety. Checks questions before they reach the LLM (prompt injection, topic restriction, input length) and checks answers after the LLM responds (hallucination detection, content safety, PII leak detection, format compliance).

Policy modes: block (reject violations), warn (log and continue), log (silent logging).

hash.title: Fingerprinter
hash.description:
A processing component that generates a unique fingerprint (hash) of a 
document's content. It computes a deterministic hash based on the raw or 
normalized text, enabling efficient deduplication, content tracking, and 
identity verification. This component ensures that identical content, 
regardless of metadata, produces the same fingerprint for reliable comparison
and indexing.

image_cleanup.title: Cleanup
image_cleanup.description:
A component that processes an image, cleans it up for OCR tasks by converting to
gray scale, removing noise, deskewing, and enhancing contrast. If you have 'noisy'
images of lesser quality, this can significantly improve the OCR accuracy.

image_vision_gemini.title: Gemini Vision
image_vision_gemini.description:
A component that connects to Google Gemini's vision-capable models for image analysis, 
OCR, visual understanding, and scene description. Supports Gemini 2.5 and 3.x models 
with multimodal capabilities. Features robust error handling, automatic image processing, 
and flexible prompt configuration for a wide range of vision use cases.

input.description: Image to analyze with Gemini Vision models

output.description: Text analysis of the image content

input.description: Image documents to analyze with Gemini Vision models

output.description: Text analysis of each image document with original metadata (frame number, timestamp) preserved

image_vision_mistral.title: Mistral Vision
image_vision_mistral.description:
A component that connects to Mistral AI's vision-capable models for image analysis, 
OCR, and visual understanding tasks. Supports all Mistral vision models including 
Mistral Large 3, Medium 3.1, Small 3.2, and Ministral models. Features robust error 
handling, automatic image processing, and flexible prompt configuration for various use cases.

image_vision_ollama.title: Ollama Vision
image_vision_ollama.description:
A component that connects to locally-hosted open-source vision models through Ollama 
for image analysis, description, and visual understanding tasks. Supports Llama 3.2 Vision, 
LLaVA, Moondream, MiniCPM-V, and other multimodal models. Runs entirely on-premise with no 
external API keys required, ideal for privacy-sensitive applications.

image_vision_openai.title: OpenAI Vision
image_vision_openai.description:
A component that connects to OpenAI's vision-capable models for image analysis, 
OCR, visual understanding, and scene description. Supports GPT-4.1 and GPT-4o model families 
with multimodal capabilities. Features robust error handling, automatic image processing, 
and flexible prompt configuration for a wide range of vision use cases.

input.description: Image to analyze with OpenAI Vision models

output.description: Text analysis of the image content

input.description: Image documents to analyze with OpenAI Vision models

output.description: Text analysis of each image document with original metadata (frame number, timestamp) preserved

landing_ai_extract.title: Landing.ai Extract
landing_ai_extract.description:
Extracts structured fields from parsed Markdown using Landing.ai ADE and a 
JSON Schema you upload. Runs downstream of Landing.ai Parse, consuming the 
Markdown it produces and emitting the extracted key-value data.

landing_ai_parse.title: Landing.ai Parse
landing_ai_parse.description:
Parses documents with Landing.ai Agentic Document Extraction (ADE), 
extracting clean Markdown text and structured tables from PDFs, images, 
and spreadsheets using the DPT-2 model.

llamaparse.title: LlamaParse
llamaparse.description:
A document parsing component that uses LlamaParse to extract text and structured data 
from various document formats including PDFs, images, Word documents, Excel spreadsheets, 
and other formats. It provides high-quality text extraction with support for tables, 
layout preservation, and markdown output formatting. 
Note: output is flattened to Markdown and does not preserve cell-level provenance 
(page boundaries, bbox coordinates, or the table-HTML cell grid), so it is not suitable 
for audit-grade or provenance-bearing extraction; use the datalab_parse node for 
structure-preserving parsing with page and coordinate data.

llm_anthropic.title: Anthropic
llm_anthropic.description:
A component that integrates with Anthropic's Claude models for natural 
language understanding and generation. It enables tasks such as 
summarization, question answering, content generation, and conversational 
AI. Configurable with model selection and prompt settings, the component 
provides access to Claude's advanced language capabilities with a strong focus 
on safety, alignment, and reliability. Ideal for enterprise-grade workflows requiring 
trustworthy AI outputs.

llm_baidu_qianfan.title: Baidu Qianfan
llm_baidu_qianfan.description:
A component that connects to Baidu Qianfan ERNIE large language models through 
Qianfan's OpenAI-compatible chat-completions API. It supports chat-based text generation, 
question answering, summarization, and Chinese-language enterprise AI workflows with configurable 
API keys and base URLs.

llm_bedrock.title: Amazon Bedrock
llm_bedrock.description:
A component that connects to Amazon Bedrock, providing access to a range 
of foundation models from leading AI providers through a unified AWS interface. 
It supports text generation, summarization, classification, and other natural language 
processing tasks. With flexible model selection and secure, serverless deployment, the 
component integrates seamlessly into AWS-powered pipelines, offering scalable, 
enterprise-ready AI capabilities without managing infrastructure.

llm_deepseek.title: Deepseek
llm_deepseek.description:
A component that connects to DeepSeek’s large language models for advanced 
natural language processing. It enables capabilities like text generation, 
summarization, and code understanding. Optimized for technical domains, DeepSeek 
offers strong performance in handling programming-related queries, structured 
data, and domain-specific tasks. The component is suitable for integrating 
intelligent reasoning and content generation into pipelines where accuracy and 
domain adaptation are key.

llm_gemini.title: Gemini
llm_gemini.description:
A component that connects to Gemini models for advanced natural language 
processing. It supports tasks such as text generation, summarization, question 
answering, and chat-based interactions. With access to state-of-the-art language 
models like Gemini-3.1-pro with 1M token context window, this component enables 
high-quality, context-aware responses and creative text generation. Configurable 
with API keys and deployment options, it allows seamless integration into AI-driven 
workflows with scalable performance.

llm_gmi_cloud.title: GMI Cloud
llm_gmi_cloud.description:
A component that connects to GMI Cloud's large language models for advanced 
natural language processing. GMI Cloud hosts 100+ OpenAI-compatible models 
including Llama 4, Qwen3, DeepSeek, GPT, Claude, and Gemini on owned H100/H200 
GPU infrastructure. It enables capabilities like text generation, summarization, 
reasoning, and code understanding across a wide range of open-weight and 
proprietary models through a unified OpenAI-compatible API.

llm_kimi.title: Kimi (Moonshot)
llm_kimi.description:
A component that connects to Moonshot AI's Kimi large language models for 
advanced natural language processing. It enables text generation, long-context 
reasoning, summarization, and tool use. The Kimi K2 family offers a 256K context 
window with thinking and non-thinking modes and strong agentic performance, while 
the classic Moonshot v1 models provide cost-effective options across 8K, 32K, and 
128K context sizes. The component is suitable for integrating intelligent 
reasoning and content generation into pipelines where long context and accuracy 
are key.

llm_minimax.title: MiniMax
llm_minimax.description:
A component that connects to MiniMax's large language models for advanced 
natural language processing. It enables capabilities like long-context reasoning, 
agentic workflows, multi-step tool use, and high-quality conversational generation. 
MiniMax offers an OpenAI-compatible API with strong performance across reasoning, 
writing, and coding tasks. The component is suitable for integrating MiniMax models 
into pipelines where extended context windows and efficient inference are important.

llm_mistral.title: Mistral AI
llm_mistral.description:
A component that connects to Mistral AI's advanced language models for natural language processing. 
Supports a wide range of models from large (256K context) to small (32K context), including specialized 
models for reasoning and technical tasks. Features high-quality chat completions with robust error handling 
and automatic token management.

llm_nebius.title: Nebius
llm_nebius.description:
Connects to Nebius Token Factory's OpenAI-compatible inference API.
Hosts open models (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek) for reasoning, generation, and tool-calling. This is a branded preset of the generic OpenAI-Compatible API node, so it shares the same implementation; the base URL is pinned to Nebius Token Factory.

llm_ollama.title: Ollama
llm_ollama.description:
A component that integrates with locally-hosted language models through Ollama. 
It enables on-premise text generation, summarization, and question answering 
without relying on external APIs. Ideal for privacy-sensitive applications, the 
component offers low-latency inference and supports various open-source models. It 
allows organizations to leverage LLM capabilities while maintaining full control 
over data and infrastructure.

llm_openai.title: OpenAI
llm_openai.description:
A component that connects to OpenAI's latest GPT models for advanced natural language 
processing. It supports tasks such as text generation, summarization, question 
answering, and chat-based interactions. With access to state-of-the-art language 
models like GPT-5.4, GPT-5, GPT-4o, and GPT-4o-mini, this component enables 
high-quality, context-aware responses and creative text generation. Configurable with 
API keys and deployment options, it allows seamless integration into AI-driven 
workflows with scalable performance and enhanced multimodal capabilities.

llm_openai_api.title: OpenAI-Compatible API
llm_openai_api.description:
A component that connects to any OpenAI-compatible API endpoint for language model 
inference. Supports custom base URLs for providers like Featherless, Together, Groq, 
Ollama, LM Studio, and any other OpenAI SDK-compatible service. Configure with your 
provider's base URL, API key, and model name.

llm_perplexity.title: Perplexity
llm_perplexity.description:
A component that connects to Perplexity AI's Sonar models for advanced natural language 
processing with real-time web search capabilities. It supports tasks such as research, 
question answering, and chat-based interactions with access to current web information. 
Configurable with API keys and multiple model options including reasoning and deep research 
models for comprehensive, fact-based responses.

llm_qwen.title: Qwen
llm_qwen.description:
A component that connects to Alibaba Cloud's Qwen large language models via the 
DashScope API. It supports tasks such as text generation, summarization, question 
answering, and chat-based interactions. With access to models like Qwen Max, Qwen Plus 
and Qwen Flash, this component enables high-quality, context-aware responses. Configurable 
with API keys, it allows seamless integration into AI-driven workflows with scalable 
performance.

llm_xai.title: xAI
llm_xai.description:
A component that integrates with xAI's Grok language models for intelligent text generation 
and analysis. Designed for advanced natural language understanding, it supports a wide range 
of use cases including question answering, summarization, and conversational AI. With a focus 
on reasoning and accuracy, this component provides access to cutting-edge capabilities from xAI, 
enabling rich, context-aware responses for enterprise and technical applications. Configuration 
options allow flexible deployment within secure and performance-optimized pipelines.

local-text-output.title: Local Text Output
local-text-output.description:
A target component that writes data to the file system. It supports 
outputting structured or unstructured content to files in a variety 
of formats such as JSON, CSV, or plain text. Configurable with output 
paths and naming conventions, the component enables flexible persistence 
of processed data to networked storage.

mcp_client.title: MCP Client
mcp_client.description:
Connects to an external MCP server and exposes its tools for agent tool-calling.
Transports: STDIO (local subprocess), Streamable HTTP (modern), and legacy HTTP+SSE.

memory_internal.title: Memory (Internal)
memory_internal.description:
Run-scoped keyed memory store exposed as agent tools.
Provides put, get, peek, list, and clear operations so agents can
persist intermediate results across planning waves without bloating
the LLM context window.

memory_persistent.title: Persistent Memory
memory_persistent.description:
A persistent cross-session memory node that retains data across pipeline
invocations. Supports Redis for production and in-memory backends for
testing. Provides session management, keyed storage, history tracking,
and automatic summarization of older entries.

input.description: Questions are enriched with session memory context before forwarding

output.description: Questions with memory context attached in metadata

input.description: Answers are stored in session memory for future retrieval

milvus.title: Milvus
milvus.description:
A vector database component for Milvus, enabling efficient storage, indexing, 
and retrieval of vector embeddings. It supports high-performance similarity search, 
flexible indexing strategies (IVF, HNSW), scalable deployment, and management 
of vector data for machine learning and AI retrieval workflows.

mongodb+srv.title: MongoDB Atlas
mongodb+srv.description:
A vector database component for MongoDB Atlas, enabling efficient storage and retrieval of vector embeddings using MongoDB's native vector search capabilities. It supports similarity search, filtering, and management of vector data with high performance and advanced matching capabilities using Atlas Vector Search.

MongoDB Atlas Vector Search

ner.title: Named Entity Recognition
ner.description:
A text processing component that identifies and extracts named entities from text using 
state-of-the-art transformer models. It can detect and classify entities such as persons, 
organizations, locations, dates, and more. The extracted entities are added to document 
metadata for enhanced search, filtering, and analysis capabilities.</br>
</br>
The component supports multiple pre-trained models optimized for different languages and 
use cases, from general-purpose entity recognition to specialized domains.

normalize_facts.title: Normalize Facts
normalize_facts.description:
A deterministic fact normalizer for the audit-grade financial extraction suite. Reads facts on the answers lane and cleans them with pure Python (no LLM): it parses numbers and signs (parentheses, trailing/unicode minus, thousands separators), detects and tags currency and scale (never converting, never multiplying the value), maps free-text labels to standard metric names, and de-duplicates identical facts.

The normalization is non-destructive: the raw label and value are kept, a normalized block is added, and a provenance entry records how each field was derived. Currency is tagged, not converted — conversion is the separate currency_convert_explicit node. Records that are not fact objects pass through unchanged.

ocr.title: OCR
ocr.description:
A component that extracts machine-readable text from images and scanned documents 
using optical character recognition. It enables the transformation of visual content (such 
as PDFs, screenshots, and photos) into structured text for further analysis and processing. 
Supporting various image formats and multilingual text, the component is ideal for digitizing 
printed materials, enabling search, indexing, and downstream natural language tasks.

opensearch.title: OpenSearch
opensearch.description:
An OpenSearch node that supports classic BM25 search and vector search 
for ingestion and retrieval workflows. Works with self-managed OpenSearch.

parse.title: Parser
parse.description:
A document parsing component that extracts rich content from a wide variety 
of document types. It automatically identifies and processes embedded content, 
producing structured outputs including plain text, tables, images, audio, and 
video. This enables comprehensive analysis of complex documents and media files 
by making their contents accessible for downstream processing in the pipeline. 
Note: output is flattened to Markdown and does not preserve cell-level provenance 
(page boundaries, bbox coordinates, or the table-HTML cell grid), so it is not suitable 
for audit-grade or provenance-bearing extraction; use the datalab_parse node for 
structure-preserving parsing with page and coordinate data.

pinecone.title: Pinecone
pinecone.description:
A component that connects to the Pinecone vector database for storing and retrieving 
high-dimensional embeddings. It enables efficient similarity search, indexing, and 
management of vectorized data, such as text or image embeddings. Configurable with 
API credentials, index settings, and metadata filtering, the component supports fast 
and scalable operations across large embedding datasets. Ideal for semantic search, 
recommendation systems, and retrieval-augmented generation workflows.

pose_estimation.title: Pose Estimation
pose_estimation.description:
Top-down human pose estimation using RTMPose (Apache-2.0) via the rtmlib ONNX wrapper. 
RTMDet-nano performs person detection first, then RTMPose predicts 17 COCO keypoints per person crop. 
Image or document in; annotated frame out with the per-person keypoint array attached to the document's metadata. 
v1 is human-only (Sapiens deferred pending license review).

input.description: AVI image stream to run pose estimation on.

output.description: Annotated image as raw stream - skeleton + keypoint overlay.
JSON array of persons: [{label: 'person', box, keypoints: [{name, x, y, score}, ...]}].

postgres.title: PostgreSQL (pgvector)
postgres.description:
A component that enhances PostgreSQL with vector similarity search 
capabilities through the pgvector extension. It allows for storing and querying of 
high-dimensional vectors directly within your existing PostgreSQL database. 
This component is ideal for building AI-powered applications that require semantic search, 
recommendation engines, and other similarity-based features without the need 
for a separate, specialized vector database.

preprocessor_code.title: Code
preprocessor_code.description:
A specialized component designed to parse and tokenize source code. It extracts 
structural elements such as functions, classes, and comments, enabling deeper semantic 
analysis. This component prepares source files for tasks like classification, embedding, 
or search by breaking them into meaningful syntactic units. Supporting multiple programming 
languages, it enables intelligent workflows involving code understanding, summarization, 
and reasoning.

preprocessor_langchain.title: General Text
preprocessor_langchain.description:
A preprocessing component that segments large bodies of text into intelligently sized 
chunks for downstream processing. It recursively splits content based on a hierarchy 
of separators (such as paragraphs, sentences, or words) preserving context while ensuring 
each chunk meets token or length constraints. This enables efficient handling of lengthy 
documents in workflows like embedding, retrieval, or LLM-based generation. Ideal for 
preparing content for language models where context length and coherence are critical.

preprocessor_llm.title: LLM
preprocessor_llm.description:
A processing component that analyzes document content to extract concise 
summaries, key points, and named entities and to divide a document for 
storage into a vector database.

llm.description: LLM to use to process the document

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description:
A transformation component that takes multiple inputs and merges them 
into a single question with a configurable prompt. This component is 
designed to work with chat, retrieval, or document systems, taking 
questions, documents, text, and tables as input and combining them 
with contextual prompts to improve LLM responses.

qdrant.title: Qdrant
qdrant.description:
A vector database component for Qdrant, enabling efficient storage and 
retrieval of vector embeddings. It supports similarity search, filtering, 
and management of vector data with high performance and advanced matching capabilities.

question.title: Question
question.description:
A transformation component that takes input text and encapsulates 
it as a Question object without modification. Designed for structured 
pipelines where raw text is to be handled as a question entity, this 
component enables consistent formatting and downstream processing without 
generating or altering content. If no question is provided, 
the component will skip processing and allow the 
pipeline to continue to the next component without sending a question.

reducto.title: Reducto
reducto.description:
A parsing component that uses Reducto to extract text and structured data 
from various document formats including PDFs, images, and other document types. 
It provides high-quality text extraction with support for tables, layout preservation, 
and multiple output formats.

remote.title: Remote Processing
remote.description:
A transport component that forwards data to a remote machine or 
processing node. It enables distributed pipeline architectures by 
offloading computation or specialized tasks to external systems. Configurable 
with network endpoints, authentication, and serialization settings, 
it supports scalable and modular deployment across environments.

rerank_cohere.title: Cohere Rerank
rerank_cohere.description:
A reranking component powered by Cohere's Rerank API that improves 
search quality by reordering retrieved documents based on their 
relevance to a given query. Supports the rerank-english-v3.0 and rerank-v3.5 models 
with configurable top-K selection and minimum score thresholds.

input.description: Takes questions with retrieved documents and reranks them by relevance.

output.description: Produces reranked documents ordered by relevance score.
Produces an answer with reranked documents.

response_answers.title: Return Answers
response_answers.description:
A component that returns processed answers back to the requesting client. It handles the 
response phase of the HTTP request-response cycle by returning the results as a JSON 
object. This component ensures that data is transmitted efficiently and clearly to 
the client, providing a standardized format for the response.

response_audio.title: Return Audio
response_audio.description:
A component that returns processed audio back to the requesting client. It handles the 
response phase of the HTTP request-response cycle by returning the results as a JSON 
object. This component ensures that data is transmitted efficiently and clearly to 
the client, providing a standardized format for the response.

response_documents.title: Return Documents
response_documents.description:
A component that returns processed documents back to the requesting client. It handles the 
response phase of the HTTP request-response cycle by returning the results as a JSON 
object. This component ensures that data is transmitted efficiently and clearly to 
the client, providing a standardized format for the response.

response_image.title: Return Image
response_image.description:
A component that returns processed images back to the requesting client. It handles the 
response phase of the HTTP request-response cycle by returning the results as a JSON 
object. This component ensures that data is transmitted efficiently and clearly to 
the client, providing a standardized format for the response.

response_json.title: Return JSON
response_json.description:
A component that returns structured JSON data back to the requesting client. It handles 
the response phase of the HTTP request-response cycle by returning the results as a JSON 
object. This component ensures that data is transmitted efficiently and clearly to 
the client, providing a standardized format for the response.

response_questions.title: Return Questions
response_questions.description:
A component that returns processed questions back to the requesting client. It handles the 
response phase of the HTTP request-response cycle by returning the results as a JSON 
object. This component ensures that data is transmitted efficiently and clearly to 
the client, providing a standardized format for the response.

response_table.title: Return Table
response_table.description:
A component that returns processed tables back to the requesting client. It handles the 
response phase of the HTTP request-response cycle by returning the results as a JSON 
object. This component ensures that data is transmitted efficiently and clearly to 
the client, providing a standardized format for the response.

response_text.title: Return Text
response_text.description:
A component that returns processed text back to the requesting client. It handles the 
response phase of the HTTP request-response cycle by returning the results as a JSON 
object. This component ensures that data is transmitted efficiently and clearly to 
the client, providing a standardized format for the response.

response_video.title: Return Video
response_video.description:
A component that returns processed video back to the requesting client. It handles the 
response phase of the HTTP request-response cycle by returning the results as a JSON 
object. This component ensures that data is transmitted efficiently and clearly to 
the client, providing a standardized format for the response.

rocketride_graph.title: RocketRide Graph
rocketride_graph.description:
A RocketRide-managed graph database backed by PostgreSQL + Apache AGE. 
Answers natural-language questions over your own provisioned RocketRide cloud 
graph with zero setup — no host, user, or password to enter; the connection is 
resolved automatically from your signed-in RocketRide identity. Cypher queries 
are translated to AGE with a resource firewall, and safe reads run in read-only 
transactions server-side.

llm.description: LLM to use to craft Cypher queries from question

rocketride_sql.title: RocketRide SQL
rocketride_sql.description:
A RocketRide-managed relational database. Stores structured table data 
in your own provisioned RocketRide cloud database with zero setup — no host, 
user, or password to enter. The connection is resolved automatically from 
your signed-in RocketRide identity. Supports the same natural-language query, 
schema reflection, and direct-execute surface as the generic PostgreSQL node.

llm.description: LLM to use to craft SQL queries from question

rocketride_vector.title: RocketRide Vector
rocketride_vector.description:
A RocketRide-managed vector store backed by PostgreSQL + pgvector. Stores 
and semantically searches high-dimensional embeddings in your own provisioned 
RocketRide cloud database with zero setup — no host, user, or password to enter; 
the connection is resolved automatically from your signed-in RocketRide identity. 
An HNSW index is created on first write so semantic search is fast from the start.

schema_validate.title: Schema Validate
schema_validate.description:
A guard node for the audit-grade financial extraction suite. It flags inconsistencies in structured facts — most notably a cost row stored as revenue (and other metric/category mismatches, sign-convention violations, and missing amounts/currency) — and makes sure provenance is never dropped. Reads and writes the answers lane.

Validation is non-destructive: original fields are kept, a validation block (valid, severity, flags) is added, and a provenance entry records that the fact was checked. Records that are not fact objects pass through unchanged; nothing is ever dropped or fixed.

search_exa.title: Exa Search
search_exa.description:
A direct Exa web search node.
Accepts user questions and returns Exa's raw search JSON as the answer.

summarization.title: Summarization: LLM
summarization.description:
A processing component that analyzes document content to extract concise 
summaries, key points, and named entities. Designed to enhance understanding 
and downstream utility, it supports unstructured text and delivers structured 
insights for indexing, search, or display. Ideal for distilling key information 
from large volumes of content.

llm.description: LLM to use to summarize the document

telegram.title: Telegram Bot
telegram.description:
A Telegram Bot source node that receives messages from users via the Telegram Bot API. 
Supports text messages and media files (images, audio, voice, video, documents). 
Each message type is routed to the appropriate pipeline lane. 
Pipeline responses are automatically sent back as replies to the sender. 
Supports both long polling (for local/private setups) and webhook (for production).

text-output.title: Text Output
text-output.description:
A target component that writes data to the file system. It supports 
outputting structured or unstructured content to files in a variety 
of formats such as JSON, CSV, or plain text. Configurable with output 
paths and naming conventions, the component enables flexible persistence 
of processed data to networked storage.

thumbnail.title: Thumbnail
thumbnail.description:
A processing component that creates thumbnails from input images. It resizes 
and optimizes images for quick previews or compact storage, preserving aspect 
ratio and visual clarity.

tool_apify.title: Apify
tool_apify.description:
Exposes Apify Actors as agent tools.
Provides run_actor (run an Actor and return its dataset) and get_dataset_items.

tool_bland_ai.title: Bland AI
tool_bland_ai.description:
Make and manage AI-powered phone calls via Bland AI.
The agent can initiate outbound calls, retrieve call transcripts, and analyze completed calls.
Requires a Bland AI API key from https://www.bland.ai

tool_butterbase.title: Butterbase MCP Client
tool_butterbase.description:
Connects to the Butterbase MCP server and exposes its backend tools for agent tool-calling.
Butterbase is an AI-optimized Backend-as-a-Service (managed database, authentication, object storage, serverless functions, RAG). The agent can create apps, evolve schemas, configure auth, deploy functions, and more, as tools named butterbase.<tool>.
This is a branded preset of the generic MCP Client (Streamable HTTP), so it shares the same implementation. Prerequisite: enable Developer Mode on your Butterbase app so the agent can create/modify resources.

tool_calendar.title: Google Calendar
tool_calendar.description:
Exposes Google Calendar operations as agent tools.
List, get, create, update, move, and delete events (including recurring-series instances and natural-language quick-add); query free/busy; manage calendars and access-control (ACL) rules.
Supports incremental sync via syncToken and sends attendee invites at the write tier. Authenticates via a Google service account or user OAuth.

tool_chartjs.title: Chart (Chart.js)
tool_chartjs.description:
Generates Chart.js v4 chart configurations from data using the pipeline LLM.
The agent provides raw data and an optional chart type or description.
Returns a ```chartjs fenced code block ready for rendering in the chat UI.

llm.description: LLM used to generate Chart.js configurations from data

tool_cognee.title: Cognee
tool_cognee.description:
Persistent semantic memory backed by a Cognee server, exposed as three agent tools. 
Remember plain text, recall memory results while requesting references, and check background processing. The knowledge graph captures semantic relationships; it is not an AST, import graph, or call graph.

tool_daytona.title: Daytona
tool_daytona.description:
Gives agents an isolated Daytona cloud sandbox for running code and shell commands.
Provides run_code, run_command, upload_file and download_file on one shared ephemeral sandbox.

tool_deepl.title: DeepL
tool_deepl.description:
Exposes DeepL translation and AI rephrasing as agent tools.
Translates text into a target language or rewrites it in a chosen style or tone via the DeepL API, returning the result plus the detected source language.

tool_docs.title: Google Docs
tool_docs.description:
Exposes Google Docs operations as agent tools.
Read a document's text; create documents; append and replace text; insert images and tables; and run arbitrary batchUpdate requests (styling, named ranges, positioned inserts).
Authenticates via a Google service account or user OAuth.

tool_drive.title: Google Drive
tool_drive.description:
Exposes Google Drive operations as agent tools.
List and search files, read metadata, download binary files and export native Docs/Sheets/Slides, create/update/copy/move files and folders, manage permissions (sharing), trash and untrash, and track changes. Supports My Drive and shared drives.
Public and external-domain sharing, and permanent delete, are gated behind explicit config flags. Authenticates via a Google service account or user OAuth.

tool_exa_search.title: Exa Search
tool_exa_search.description:
Exposes Exa semantic web search as an agent tool.
Performs real-time web searches via the Exa API and returns structured results with titles, URLs, text content, relevance scores, and dates.

tool_filesystem.title: File System
tool_filesystem.description:
File system tool for agents. Reads, writes, deletes, lists, and creates directories within the account-scoped RocketRide file store (the same store exposed via the client SDK's fs_* methods).
All operations are scoped to the task's storage anchor (the owning user's file tree for development runs, the task's team subtree for deployed runs), resolved automatically from the running task.
Per-operation toggles (allowRead, allowWrite, allowDelete, allowList, allowMkdir, allowStat) gate which methods the agent can call.

tool_firecrawl.title: Firecrawl
tool_firecrawl.description:
Exposes Firecrawl web-scraping operations as agent tools.
Provides scrape_url (single page) and map_url (site structure discovery).

tool_git.title: Git
tool_git.description:
Exposes local Git repository operations as agent tools. 
Covers clone, init, status, log, show, diff, blame, stage, commit, stash, branch management, pull, push, and code search. 
Runs entirely in-process without requiring a host git installation. 
Supports secure authentication via personal access tokens and SSH keys.

tool_github.title: GitHub
tool_github.description:
Exposes GitHub repository operations as agent tools.
Covers files, issues, pull requests, reviews, releases, workflows, orgs, users,
code search, and commit history.

tool_gmail.title: Gmail
tool_gmail.description:
Exposes Gmail operations as agent tools.
Read, search, label, draft, send, and organize mail; permanent delete available with full access.
Authenticates via a Google service account or user OAuth.

tool_gohighlevel.title: GoHighLevel
tool_gohighlevel.description:
Exposes the GoHighLevel (LeadConnector) v2 REST API as agent tools.
Covers contacts, notes, tasks, opportunities, pipelines, conversations, messages,
calendars, appointments, custom fields, custom values, tags, businesses and users.

tool_guild.title: Guild.ai
tool_guild.description:
Run Guild.ai agents from a RocketRide pipeline or an agent.
As a pipeline step, lane input is sent to a configured Guild agent as a session and its answer flows downstream; as a tool, an agent can start Guild sessions and inspect their status and transcript.
Guild is the control plane for AI agents — RocketRide prepares the data, a governed Guild agent performs the action.

tool_http_request.title: HTTP Request
tool_http_request.description:
Makes HTTP requests to any API endpoint, like curl for agents.
The agent provides the full request (method, URL, headers, body, auth).
The node enforces security guardrails: only whitelisted URLs and enabled HTTP methods are permitted.

tool_laserdata_memory.title: LaserData Memory
tool_laserdata_memory.description:
Durable, shared agent memory exposed as tools, backed by LaserData (Apache Iggy) via the Laser SDK.
Exposes four agent tools: 'remember' stores a statement, 'recall' returns the most relevant items, 'improve' reinforces a memory with feedback, and 'forget' deletes one. Pick your deployment (local Apache Iggy or LaserData Cloud), set the connection string and a namespace, and it works; point several agents at the same namespace to share one durable memory.

tool_mem0.title: Mem0
tool_mem0.description:
Long-term, shared agent memory exposed as tools, backed by the hosted Mem0 Platform.
Exposes two agent tools: 'remember' stores conversation turns and 'recall' returns the relevant memories. Set your API key and a user id and it works; point several agents at the same project (and ids) to share one memory.

tool_n8n.title: n8n
tool_n8n.description:
Trigger n8n workflows from a RocketRide pipeline or an agent.
As a pipeline step, lane input is POSTed to a workflow's webhook and the response flows downstream; as a tool, an agent can trigger workflows and inspect workflows/executions.
Self-hosted: configure the n8n base URL and (for listing/polling) a public API key.

tool_oura.title: Oura
tool_oura.description:
Exposes Oura Ring health data as read-only agent tools.
Covers daily sleep, readiness, activity, stress, resilience, SpO2, heart rate,
workouts, sessions, tags, VO2 max, cardiovascular age, battery level, and personal info.

tool_pipe.title: Pipeline Tool
tool_pipe.description:
Exposes an inline pipeline as an agent tool.
Connect this node's output lanes to any pipeline nodes on the same canvas.
When an agent calls the tool, the input is routed to every connected output lane.
End each connected branch with a response node to return results.

tool_pipedrive.title: Pipedrive
tool_pipedrive.description:
Exposes the Pipedrive CRM REST API v1 as agent tools.
Covers deals, persons, organizations, activities, pipelines, stages, notes, leads,
products, files, users, teams, goals, projects, and every other v1 resource.

tool_python.title: Python
tool_python.description:
Executes Python code in a restricted in-process sandbox via exec().
Only whitelisted modules can be imported. Dangerous builtins are removed.

tool_sheets.title: Google Sheets
tool_sheets.description:
Exposes Google Sheets operations as agent tools.
Read, write, append, and clear cell values; create spreadsheets; add, delete, duplicate, and copy sheets; and run arbitrary batchUpdate requests (formatting, charts, conditional formatting).
Authenticates via a Google service account or user OAuth.

tool_slack.title: Slack
tool_slack.description:
Exposes Slack workspace operations as agent tools.
Post messages to channels or threads, list public channels, read channel history,
and verify the connection. Authenticates with a bot token, or an incoming-webhook
URL for zero-scope post-only setups.

tool_tavily.title: Tavily
tool_tavily.description:
Exposes Tavily real-time web search as an agent tool.
Performs live web searches via the Tavily API and returns structured results with titles, URLs, content snippets, and relevance scores.

tool_v0.title: v0 by Vercel
tool_v0.description:
A component that connects to Vercel's v0 API to generate React + Tailwind CSS UI 
components from natural-language prompts. Supports generate_ui (create a new component 
from a description) and refine_ui (iterate on a previous generation with follow-up 
instructions). Experimental: API availability and behavior may change.

tool_xtrace_memory.title: xTrace Memory
tool_xtrace_memory.description:
Long-term, shared agent memory exposed as tools, backed by xTrace Memory Manager.
Exposes two agent tools: 'remember' stores conversation turns and 'recall' returns the relevant, ready-to-inject context. Set your API key and org id and it works; point several agents at the same org (and group) to share one memory.

tools.title: Tools
tools.description:
A source component that transfers no data: it exists to host tool nodes. 
Connect tools to it via the tool invoke channel and call them directly from 
a client with client.tool() - no agent, no LLM, no data lanes. Ideal for 
pipelines whose whole purpose is exposing capabilities (file storage, vector 
store management, integrations) to an application.

tool.description: Tools hosted by this endpoint (via control-plane invoke)

tts_elevenlabs.title: Text To Speech (ElevenLabs)
tts_elevenlabs.description:
Converts incoming text into speech using the ElevenLabs text-to-speech API.
Calls the vendor API directly from the engine host over HTTPS and emits MP3 bytes on the audio lane.
The model and voice lists are maintained manually; the API key falls back to the ELEVENLABS_API_KEY environment variable when blank.

tts_openai.title: Text To Speech (OpenAI)
tts_openai.description:
Converts incoming text into speech using the OpenAI text-to-speech API.
Calls the vendor API directly from the engine host over HTTPS and emits MP3 bytes on the audio lane.
Model and voice lists are maintained manually; the API key falls back to the OPENAI_API_KEY environment variable when blank.

twelvelabs.title: TwelveLabs
twelvelabs.description: Sends a video to TwelveLabs along with instructions and returns the generated text response.

video_composer.title: Video Composer
video_composer.description:
Stitches a sequence of image frames into an MP4 video using FFmpeg. 
Place after any image-producing filter to re-encode matched frames into 
a playable video clip.

input.description: Image frames to stitch into a video.

output.description: Encoded MP4 video from the input frames.

weaviate.title: Weaviate
weaviate.description:
A component that stores vector embeddings in a Weaviate instance 
for semantic search and retrieval. It supports structured metadata and schema 
configuration, enabling efficient storage, indexing, and querying 
of high-dimensional data. Ideal for AI pipelines involving similarity search, 
recommendation systems, and knowledge management.

webhook.title: Webhook
webhook.description:
A source component that listens for incoming HTTP requests and accepts 
uploaded documents or data from external systems or processes. It enables 
seamless integration for document ingestion, allowing external systems to 
trigger the component and send files for further processing. Configurable 
with endpoint and authentication settings, it ensures secure and reliable 
document transfer for pipeline processing. Ideal for receiving documents, 
images, or other files from external platforms via HTTP-based communication.
